{{Quote|I think we just got a random thief which explains why he didn't put up a fight. Probably all he could do was to switch on the lightsaber and wave it around|IC-1309 "Niner"|<ref name="Imperial Commando: 501st">''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]''</ref>}}
A common '''thief''' operated on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in the early days of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] he was pulled over by [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] [[Officer/Legends|officers]] during which he cut off an officer's hand with a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. The CSF officers led by Officer [[Anskow]] chased the thief into the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|lower levels]] and cornered him in a building. After setting up a perimeter the CSF officers called in [[Squad 40]] of the [[Imperial Commando Special Unit]] that was attached to the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]]. The officers thought that because of the lightsaber, the thief was a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. Squad 40 stormed the building and the thief was killed by [[Ennen|IC-4447]]. In his report [[Niner Skirata|IC-1309 "Niner"]] stated that ''Lawful warning given, suspect failed to surrender, drew lightsaber, neutralized by Trooper IC-4447 Ennen.''
